::: {#exr-evaluate-nested}
#### Operation first

Racket writes $7 - 2$ as `(- 7 2)`,
with the operation first and the parentheses around the whole expression.
Guess what each Racket expression returns:

1. `(* (+ 1 2) (- 10 4))`
2. `(- 20 (* 3 (+ 1 1)))`
3. `(+ 1 2 3 4)`

Then write $(2 + 3) \cdot 4 - 1$ in Racket.

:::
